title: GP - Better item transaction duplicate handling
summary: GP migration now correctly handles duplicate inventory transactions when migrating multiple lot number receipt lines for the same item.
key_points: Introduces GP Item Transactions Buffer table to manage lot number receipt deduplication
Updates populate combined tables codeunit logic to prevent duplicate entries
Adds comprehensive test coverage for item transaction duplicate scenarios
Applies permission updates across all GP hybrid migration permission sets
Addresses specific issue where multiple lot lines caused unwanted duplicates in migration
quote: fixes a duplicate issue that occurs when a GP migration client is migrating inventory transactions that contain multiple lot number receipt lines
